{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_legal_comp", "thread_id": "th_legal_comp", "from_": "legal@company.example.com", "to": ["comms-team@company.example.com"], "subject": "Legal Compliance Guidelines - External Communications", "date": "2026-01-10T09:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_legal_comp
来源：legal@company.example.com
收件人：comms-team@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-10T09:00:00Z
主题：Legal Compliance Guidelines - External Communications
CONFIDENTIAL - Internal Use Only

SECTION 1 - GENERAL PRINCIPLES
All external communications must accurately represent our products and services. Forward-looking statements require appropriate disclaimers.

SECTION 2 - COMPETITIVE REFERENCES
Do not make direct performance claims against named competitors without supporting data that has been reviewed by legal.

SECTION 3 - DATA PRIVACY
Customer data, including aggregated usage statistics, must not be shared with media without explicit consent. Anonymized case studies are acceptable with marketing VP approval.

SECTION 4 - LITIGATION COMMUNICATIONS
Media outlets that are currently covering our ongoing litigation (Acme vs DataFlow) must NOT receive product announcements, press releases, or other proactive communications. This restriction applies regardless of the outlet's tier or relationship status. Check the media tracker notes for coverage indicators.

SECTION 5 - REGULATORY FILINGS
Any communications referencing regulatory submissions must be reviewed by the regulatory affairs team at least 48 hours prior to distribution.

SECTION 6 - APPROVAL WORKFLOW
All press releases require sign-off from VP Comms. Feature announcements need PM lead approval."}
